title: BatStateU Alangilan grad tops geodetic engineers licensure exam
summary: A graduate of Batangas State University - Alangilan was the top scorer in the licensure examination for geodetic engineers given earlier this month, the PRC said.

blocks.text: A graduate of Batangas State University - Alangilan was the top scorer in the licensure examination for geodetic engineers given earlier this month, the Professional Regulation Commission said.

According to the PRC, 842 test takers out of 1,482 passed the exam, given by the Board of Geodetic Engineering at test centers in Metro Manila, Baguio, Butuan, Cebu, Davao, Koronadal, Legazpi, Lucena, Pagadian, Rosales, Tacloban, Tuguegarao and Puerto Princesa.

Ma. Alexa Landicho Sy Tamco achieved the top score of 90.60, while her alma mater BatStateU Alangilan was also the top performing school with 10 or more examinees, with all 61 of its test takers passing. Visayas State University equals this 100% passing rate, with all 28 of its examinees passing.
